title: Mean-field equilibrium of heterogeneous agents under market impact
abstract: arXiv:2609.03115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although market participants generally have access to a common information set, they make decisions based on forecasts formed over heterogeneous horizons. Because market impact depends on aggregate positions rather than trader identities, these decisions feed back into prices through their collective effect. We introduce a linear mean-field model of this interaction. The observed price is decomposed into a martingale component, a common predictable signal represented by a Volterra process, and the market impact generated by aggregate positions. Agents take positions according to conditional forecasts of future signal increments and a fraction of anticipated aggregate impact over their respective horizons. Within a Gaussian-Volterra framework, we characterize equilibrium through a linear fixed-point equation for aggregate positions and establish existence and uniqueness under explicit conditions. translated_title: 市场冲击下异质主体的平均场均衡
translated_abstract: 尽管市场参与者通常能够获取共同的信息集，但他们基于在不同视界（时间尺度）上形成的预测做出决策。由于市场冲击取决于总持仓而非交易者身份，这些决策通过其集体效应反馈到价格中。我们引入了一个刻画这种互动的线性平均场模型。观测到的价格被分解为鞅分量、由Volterra过程表示的共同可预测信号，以及由总持仓产生的市场冲击。交易主体根据对未来信号增量的条件预测以及其各自视界内预期总冲击的一部分来建立头寸。在高斯-Volterra框架下，我们通过总持仓的线性不动点方程刻画了均衡，并在明确的条件下证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性。在均衡状态下，我们识别出一种平衡条件……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个线性平均场模型，刻画具有异质预测视界的交易主体通过市场冲击与价格之间的反馈互动，并借助总持仓的线性不动点方程在明确条件下证明了均衡的存在性与唯一性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a linear mean-field model of interaction between traders with heterogeneous forecasting horizons and price impact, characterizing equilibrium through a linear fixed-point equation for aggregate positions and establishing existence and uniqueness under explicit conditions.
